newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay bourse cancels holiday, open on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Bombay bourse cancels holiday, open on Monday.

text.p: The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) has cancelled a holiday and will stay open on Monday for normal business, the exchange said.
The change was made after brokers complained that other bourses were open on Monday, BSE executive director R.C. Mathur said in a statement issued late Friday.
The National Stock Exchange which operates from 83 centres across India had not declared a holiday for the Moslem festival of Ramzan Id.
Most banks, government offices and companies are closed on Monday.
